KXNCAAF1QBTTS.note: No markets listed (rules sample NO_MARKETS_LISTED) so NO_LISTING/low is honest. BTTS in Q1 is the joint of each team's Q1 points being >=1, i.e. period team-total scoreless mass, generated by the quarter_and_half_totals mechanism, not period margin.

KXNCAAF2QBTTS.note: Same as Q1: no listed markets, NO_LISTING/low correct; outcome = both teams' 2nd-quarter points >0, a period team-total (zero-mass) event, so quarter_and_half_totals rather than quarter sides.

KXNCAAF3QBTTS.note: Same as Q1/Q2: no listed markets, NO_LISTING/low correct; 3rd-quarter both-teams-score is a period team-total zero-mass event fitting quarter_and_half_totals.

KXNCAAFCS.note: No markets listed; FCS champion is decided by team strength through the FCS playoff bracket, the same mechanism season_futures models (only the data universe differs). Family of lower-division titles does not have a distinct outcome mechanism, so no new archetype.

KXNCAAFD3.note: No markets listed; D3 champion is a bracket/title outcome driven by team strength, which is the season_futures mechanism. Data coverage for D3 is thin, but that is a data gap, not a distinct archetype.

KXNCAAFDRAFTDECLARE.note: Rules: player 'publicly and unequivocally announces' NFL draft entry before Feb 2, 2027. Not an award. Player-career-decision family has only 2 series (with KXNCAAFTRANSFER), below the 4-series threshold, and the coaching/transfer archetype already models announcement-by-date personnel decisions.

KXNCAAFDSTTD.note: Rules: both teams 'collectively record at least 1 defensive or special teams touchdown', OT counts. Game-level TD count threshold; game_stat_props explicitly targets TD counts per official stats, so the 6-series TD-count family has an existing generating archetype.

KXNCAAFFCS.note: Rules: named team 'wins the FCS National Championship in the 2026-27 season'. Bracket title outcome = season_futures mechanism; RULES_TEXT/high acceptable. Duplicate-scope of KXNCAAFCS (unlisted) noted.

KXNCAAFFIRSTTDTEAM.note: Rules: which team scores the first touchdown, all TD types, OT counts. A team-level race (opening possession, first-drive efficiency) rather than a count; single series, game_stat_props (TD stat outcomes) is the closest existing archetype at medium confidence; not a named-player scorer.

KXNCAAFHIGHSCORE.note: Rules: Yes if any Division I regular-season game exceeds 144.5 total points. The outcome is the upper tail of per-game total points (pace, efficiency, overtime) maxed over all D-I games; season_futures (team strength -> standings/titles/awards) does not generate it. Moved to game_total.

KXNCAAFIVY.note: No markets listed; Ivy title is standings-based (no title game, shared titles possible) - a settlement nuance for season_futures conference-title modelling, not a distinct mechanism. NO_LISTING/low correct.

KXNCAAFPAC10.note: No markets listed and 'Pac-10' is a defunct conference name, so entity and settlement are unverifiable; still a CFB conference-title outcome, so season_futures at low confidence is the honest filing rather than out-of-scope.

KXNCAAFTEAMRECTD.note: Rules: team 'records 1+ receiving touchdowns', fumble-recovery edge rules, OT counts. Team TD-count threshold per official stats = game_stat_props (target explicitly lists TDs); not a named-player scorer market.

KXNCAAFTEAMRSHATT.note: No markets listed, so NO_LISTING/low is honest. Team rushing attempts = plays x run share, a team stat threshold; game_stat_props fits (like KXNCAAFTEAMRECYDS); sack/kneel counting unverifiable.

KXNCAAFTEAMRSHTD.note: Rules: team 'records 5+ rushing touchdowns', OT counts, own-fumble-recovery edge rule. Team TD count threshold = game_stat_props; touchdown_scorer (named player) is the wrong archetype.

KXNCAAFTEAMTD.note: Rules: team 'records 5+ touchdowns', OT counts, 2-pt conversions excluded. Team TD count = game_stat_props; strongly correlated with team_total points but settles on TD count, so game_stat_props is right.

KXNCAAFTOTALTD.note: Rules: both teams 'collectively record 8+ touchdowns', OT counts. Game TD count threshold = game_stat_props; existing archetype generates it, so no new team_and_game_touchdown_counts archetype is warranted.

KXNCAAFTRANSFER.note: Rules: player 'announced to be joining' a named school before Feb 2, 2027 (stays/declares/commits elsewhere legs). Matches the existing 'Player transfer destination' contract type of coaching_and_governance_events; RULES_TEXT/high fine.

KXNCAAFHIGHSCORE.quote: If there is a Division I game (including overtime) with over 144.5 total points scored in the 2026 college football regular season
KXNCAAFHIGHSCORE.reason: Settles Yes if any Division I regular-season game (overtime included; conference title, bowl and CFP games excluded) exceeds 144.5 total points. The generating process is per-game total points (pace, efficiency, overtime) evaluated as a season maximum across all D-I games, i.e. the game_total mechanism with an extreme-value aggregation; season_futures (team strength into standings, titles, awards) does not produce this outcome.
